name: Structured Data Extraction Pipeline
description: A Python scraper that gathers character names and profile URLs from category pages and exports them to CSV.
highlights: Scrapes character links from paginated category pages
Exports structured name and URL records to CSV

details.context: The repository describes a modular scraper for hierarchical data sources. The current example extracts character links from A Song of Ice and Fire fandom category pages.

architecture.label: Run the script
steps: Parse names and links with Beautiful Soup

dataModel: The current CSV output has name and url fields for each character.
There is no database layer in the current implementation.
apiDesign: There is no REST API in the current implementation. The repository README lists an API as future work.
futureImprovements: Add request error handling and retry/backoff.
Add persistent storage and an API layer.

name: MoodShare
description: A small social app for sharing short thoughts and moods, following people, and reading a personalized feed.
highlights: Server-rendered pages and a JSON REST API
User, post, follow, and like relationships
Login sessions for the web app and JWT auth for API clients

details.context: MoodShare lets people share short posts, follow other users, and see a personalized feed. Posts are limited to 140 characters in the current API.

architecture.label: REST API
steps: Flask API blueprint and JWT check

dataModel: User → Post is one-to-many; each post stores its author's user_id.
User ↔ User follows are stored in the followers association table.
User ↔ Post likes are stored in the likes association table.
apiDesign: POST /api/auth/login issues a JWT for an API client.
GET /api/posts returns paginated posts; POST /api/posts creates one.
POST and DELETE /api/posts/{id}/like add or remove a like.
The API blueprint applies token authentication to protected routes.
details.implementationNotes: The codebase separates page routes, API routes, and SQLAlchemy models. The Flask app factory registers the API blueprint and exempts its token-authenticated routes from form CSRF checks.
